::: {#rem-information-gain}
#### Information gain is mutual information

Draw one point uniformly at random from the node of @def-information-gain,
and let $Y$ be its class and $X$ the branch it falls into.
Then the entropy at the node is $H(Y)$,
the weighted entropy left in the branches is $H(Y \mid X)$,
and the information gain is the [mutual information](#def-mutual-information) $I(X; Y)$.

:::
